senses.definition_en: pluviometer

examples.english: Little has been said, for instance, about his support for the agricultural applications of meteorology and the creation of a pluviometric network capable of covering the entire archipelago to understand more precisely the spatial and seasonal distribution of rainfall, with that data being put to use toward the ongoing farming projects.
examples.ref: 2016 August 12, “El don de hacer lo imposible”, in Granma:
examples.text: Poco se ha dicho por ejemplo de que fue el promotor de las aplicaciones de la meteorología en la agricultura y de crear una red pluviométrica capaz de cubrir todo el archipiélago para conocer con mayor precisión la distribución espacial y estacional de las precipitaciones, poniendo esos datos en función de los nuevos planes agrícolas en marcha.
examples.translation: Little has been said, for instance, about his support for the agricultural applications of meteorology and the creation of a pluviometric network capable of covering the entire archipelago to understand more precisely the spatial and seasonal distribution of rainfall, with that data being put to use toward the ongoing farming projects.

examples.english: The first two pluviometric phenomena, which made almost all streets of the province's capital collapse, were recorded this Tuesday after 7 p.m.
examples.ref: 2024 March 19, “Inundación en La Plata: autos flotando y barrios enteros bajo el agua por la tormenta supercelda”, in Clarín:
examples.text: Este martes después de las 19 se registró el primero de los dos fenómenos pluviométricos que hicieron colapsar las calles en casi todos los barrios de la capital de la provincia.
examples.translation: The first two pluviometric phenomena, which made almost all streets of the province's capital collapse, were recorded this Tuesday after 7 p.m.

glosses: pluviometer
